steps.content: Once again, you narrowly escape the darkness. When you open your eyes, the first thing you see is Shin's worried face.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You fainted again...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Don't be afraid. They'll be back soon. We'll make it to shore. Banyan will heal you. No one can hurt you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No... something's wrong! Listen!
You struggle to get up, pointing at the door.
The clanging draws closer, very, very slowly.
So slow, it couldn't be a human walking...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They've been gone too long.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The banging is louder than when they left... but why haven't they come back?
Everyone senses something deeply wrong with the sound. Yet it continues approaching, one clang after another, a deafening clamor that splits your skull.
Clang... clang...
Clang clang... clang...
Clang clang clang clang...

steps.speaker: Crew Member
steps.content: D-don't scare us. If it's not them coming back...
Her voice cracks with tears.

steps.speaker: Crew Member
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Then what's getting closer to us now?</color>
The banging gets closer. Soon, you realize, it's not just coming from outside the door!
Frenzied clanging bursts from all the metal walls.
Every pipe is screaming. Every steel plate is quaking. The entire ship seems to groan in agony, grating on your nerves.
Then, suddenly, the banging stops.
Something huge has stopped at the door. The next instant, the walls are shaken by violent slams.
THOOM! THOOM!
This is nothing like the sound of the metal pipe. Only something enormous can make these booming sounds.

steps.speaker: Crew Members
steps.content: Aaaahhh!
The crew shrieks. Laura's fragile nerves finally snap, and she clings to Shin in terror.
Whatever the thing... It is right outside.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Stay calm! We can't let them in!

Shin shoves Laura to a nearby crewmate, then grabs an iron chain and wraps it around the door handle. But it's not enough. The thing outside starts crawling fast, the sound of its wet, grimy steps reverberating across the walls and ceiling as it barrels toward the front porthole.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Hehehe... Hahahahaha...
Ragnar has somehow gotten to his feet, eyes transfixed on the door as peals of maniacal laughter burst from his throat. But no one has time for him right now.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: The window!
The crew member holding Laura musters her courage and leaps toward the window. But the moment she reaches for it, the darkness outside coils around her injured arm and yanks her violently through.

steps.speaker: Injured Crew Member
steps.content: Aaaahhh!!
She lets out a blood-curdling scream, desperately clawing at the window ledge, her fingernails screeching against the metal, leaving bloody streaks.

steps.speaker: Injured Crew Member
steps.content: Help me! Somebody help me!

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: Don't let go! Someone, anyone, help us! HELP US!!!
The next second, the window slams shut. The darkness devours her whole, leaving only a few bloodied fingers rolling across the console.

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: Ah... Aaaahhh... AAAAHHHHH...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: What's going on?!
Screams, pounding, and scraping against metal fill the air, drowning Pylgia's urgent cries from the radio comms.
The comms officer picks up the radio with trembling hands, but doesn't know what to say.
His whole body is shaking, threatening to seize up.
You struggle to sit up, yelling, trying to steady him.
But Teto doesn't seem to hear you. He stares blankly at the writhing darkness beyond the porthole, hesitantly bringing the radio to his lips. He forces out a warning, word by word.

steps.speaker: Teto
steps.content: Don't... come back... Out... side... there's...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: What? There's what outside?

steps.speaker: Teto
steps.content: There's... Gaaaarghhhh!!!
Black tentacles erupt from his mouth, silencing his words. His body bloats like a balloon stuffed with leeches before bursting with a sickening pop.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Hahaha... Haha... HAHAHAHAHA...

As he watches his crewmates burst one by one, Ragnar's laughter grows louder, shriller, almost piercing your eardrums. He admires the scene like a detached spectator before a mural of hell, every last shred of his sanity gone.

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: No! This can't be happening...
Reid has snapped. Clutching his axe, he starts toward Ragnar.

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: He's... he's turning... Can't let him live...

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: I'm... I'm gonna kill you! This is all your fault! If it weren't for you... I should've killed you from the start!!

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Stop! Reid, guard the helm!

Shin grabs another metal rod and jams it into the door handle. The battering outside weakens for a moment. She stops Reid and turns to restrain Ragnar, trying to secure the wheelhouse's last line of defense.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: He's not turning! It's safe in here for now. We just have to keep that thing out!

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Reid! Do you hear me?

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: Sigmund? Is that you, Sigmund?
With Shin overwhelmed, Laura suddenly rises from where she'd been sitting on the floor and stares at the door with vacant eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't go there! That's not Sigmund outside, it's...
Her gaunt face brightens with a tender smile, as if enchanted by the softened knocks on the door. You try to call her back to her senses, but it's clearly futile.

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: My dear boy, you really are alive... I was wrong... I shouldn't have been so hard on you...

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: You've always been... my pride and joy...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Stop her!
Hearing Shin's cry, you drag your broken body over and desperately try to hold her back. But Laura moves like a soulless puppet, taking one step after another toward the door.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop! He's not there!
But her strength is shocking, and your arms are growing sore. Blood seeps through her makeshift bandages, yet she seems to feel neither pain nor weight as she forcibly drags you along.

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: My boy's crying for help... How can I ignore him...

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: My boy... Mommy's coming...
You don't know what she's seen. But the instant she touches the door handle, her body dissolves like the others, melting into a puddle at the door.
Your hands pass right through her, and you tumble to the ground, collapsing onto the black ichor.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Darn it!
You slam your fist on the floor, helpless. But the unfolding horror doesn't grant you a moment's rest.

The porthole shatters, and black ichor seeps in from every crack. Like living things, they transform into writhing masses of tentacles, churning and squirming as they close in on Reid, who is still standing guard over Ragnar.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Reid! Watch out!

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Hahahaha... I saw it... It is coming for me! Hahaha!!!

At the sight of the black ichor, Ragnar's laughter turns more manic as he babbles in some unknowable tongue. He throws off Shin, who is trying to restrain him, and begins crawling toward the black ichor, dragging his bonds behind him.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: ...Ahhh!
Reid had been standing in a daze. At Shin's cry, his whole body shudders, yet he remains oblivious to the tentacles slithering up behind him. Instead, he turns to look at the two of you.

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: I... I must...

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: Aaaaargh! I don't care! To hell with this ******* world! Just DIE!!!
He raises the axe high and brings it down on Ragnar with all his strength.
The first blow takes off Ragnar's left arm. The black ichor instantly reforms the limb.
The second blow takes off the right side of his body. The black ichor once again repairs the gaps.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Haha... Hahahaha!!!
Ragnar's maniacal laughter never ceases, as if mocking Reid's futile attempts. Shin stares at the scene, paralyzed. There's nothing she can do to stop this.

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: Why... why won't you DIE?! AAAARGH!!!

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: ...No! —Reid!!
The third blow takes off Ragnar's head.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Guh...
The laughter that had tormented you stops abruptly as the severed head rolls across the floor.
Ragnar's headless body collapses into a pool of black ichor, which coils around Reid's legs as if possessed of a mind of its own. But Reid just stands there, motionless, a mournful smile on his lips.

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: I promised... I'd keep you safe... I kept my word... Captain... Heh... Hehe...
Black tears stream from Reid's eyes as torrents of dark ichor gush from his body, rushing toward you and Shin, the last two survivors left.
Unable to bear the mental strain anymore, your mind erupts in a deafening roar.
The moment before the black tide engulfs you, a flash of blue light tears your consciousness from your body. The world around you shatters like glass.
The last thing you see is Shin, sitting stunned on the floor, black ichor spattered on her face and soaking through her clothes.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Why... how did this happen...
She presses her hands to her eyes, to her face. Her crew, her companions, all dissolved into nothing before her very eyes. She is powerless, the darkness closing in to swallow her whole...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Sob... sob...
You seem to hear her crying. You see her clutching your broken body. You struggle to reach for her, but you only drift farther and farther away...
[Scene Change]
Your heart jolts as you open your eyes in the room at DisSea Monitoring Station.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, we detected signs of mental breakdown and forcibly extracted you from the illusion. How are you feeling now?
You look at the emotionless black triangle and feel an unexpected sting of envy. You lie back down without hesitation and let out a long exhale.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well then, I suppose I owe you one.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Send me back.
Schorl falls silent for only a moment before restarting the connection.
Eerie red and black intertwine as you plunge once more into that violent sea of alien hues.
